purpose: Canonical deduplicated backlog IDs preserving P2 task, edge-case and masterplan-gap provenance.

policy.stable_id: IDs are deterministic from source type and source identity.
policy.provenance: Deduplication may merge equivalent work only by preserving all source refs/provenance; it may not erase source obligations.
policy.lifecycle: Upstream dependency/evidence changes force revalidation rather than silent retirement.
policy.closure: Every item has explicit closure_rule; source maturity or risk authority is never inferred from backlog status.
